candy-coil-delay.description: Uses staggered centered-hump delay heads that pass below, through, and above the source pitch.
candy-coil-delay.start: Turn on Audio, play a sample or connect Mic/File input, then explore presets, tap a range or lock its reciprocal relationship with head speed.

sandy-syrup-delay.description: Processes bundled samples, microphone or file audio with staggered grains that can hold their rates or glide together.
sandy-syrup-delay.start: Turn on Audio, play a sample or connect Mic/File input, then explore presets or move between Sand and Syrup.

slippery-resynthesis.description: Tracks bundled samples, microphone or local-file audio across logarithmic FFT bands, then rebuilds it through endlessly slipping Shepard glissando banks with adaptive consonant excitation.
slippery-resynthesis.start: Turn on Audio and play a bundled sample, or choose Mic or File. Presets, Next and dice shape the slipping spectrum while preserving the input loop.
